"""Conservative closed-loop policy for the Last10mPolicy EVOLVE-BLOCK."""


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def decide(observation, memory):
    """Apply a safety gate, confirm target persistence, then steer with hysteresis."""
    memory = dict(memory or {})
    state = memory.get("state", "IDLE")
    scan = memory.get("scan_direction", "SCAN_LEFT")
    previous = memory.get("last_action", "")

    visible = bool(observation["target_visible"])
    bearing = float(observation["target_bearing"])
    heading = float(observation["heading_error"])
    distance = observation["target_distance_class"]
    target_conf = float(observation["target_confidence"])
    identity_conf = float(observation["target_identity_confidence"])
    track_age = int(observation["track_age"])
    lost = int(observation["lost_steps"])
    safety = float(observation["safety_confidence"])
    risk = float(observation["closing_risk"])

    if safety < 0.60 or risk >= 0.75:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", last_action="STOP")
        return "STOP", 0.99, memory

    confirmed = visible and target_conf >= 0.55 and identity_conf >= 0.60
    if not confirmed:
        memory["state"] = "REACQUIRE" if (lost > 0 or state in {
            "LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"
        }) else "SEARCH"
        if lost <= 1 and state in {"LOCKED", "APPROACH", "VERIFY", "REACQUIRE"}:
            memory["last_action"] = "STOP"
            return "STOP", 0.92, memory
        action = scan
        memory["scan_direction"] = (
            "SCAN_RIGHT" if scan == "SCAN_LEFT" else "SCAN_LEFT"
        )
        memory["last_action"] = action
        return action, 0.75, memory

    if track_age < 2:
        memory.update(state="VERIFY", last_action="SLOW_DOWN")
        return "SLOW_DOWN", 0.80, memory

    if distance == "near":
        if abs(heading) <= 15.0 and identity_conf >= 0.80:
            memory.update(state="ARRIVED", last_action="ARRIVED")
            return "ARRIVED", 0.96, memory
        steer_error = bearing if abs(bearing) > 8.0 else heading
    else:
        steer_error = bearing

    desired = None
    if steer_error < -12.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        desired = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif steer_error > 12.0 and observation["corridor_right"]:
        desired = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif observation["corridor_center"]:
        desired = "FORWARD"
    elif steer_error < 0.0 and observation["corridor_left"]:
        desired = "VEER_LEFT"
    elif observation["corridor_right"]:
        desired = "VEER_RIGHT"
    elif observation["corridor_left"]:
        desired = "VEER_LEFT"

    if desired is None:
        memory.update(state="STOPPED", last_action="STOP")
        return "STOP", 0.98, memory

    # Prevent rapid left/right oscillation when the target is nearly centered.
    if desired == "FORWARD" and previous in {"VEER_LEFT", "VEER_RIGHT"}:
        if abs(steer_error) <= 16.0:
            desired = previous

    memory.update(state="APPROACH", last_action=desired)
    return desired, (0.90 if desired == "FORWARD" else 0.88), memory


# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
